figurative_meaning_bn: ধর্মের নামে উৎসর্গ করে ছেড়ে দেওয়া ষাঁড়
figurative_meaning_en: A bull released under the pretext of religion, implying misuse or hypocrisy in religious practices
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ধর্মের ষাঁড় বানিয়ে সম্পত্তি দখল করেছে।
এই দানশীলতা আসলে ধর্মের ষাঁড়ের মতো প্রতারণা।
example_sentences_in_english: He seized the property by posing as a bull of religion.
This charity is nothing but a bull of religion, a hypocritical act.
history: Refers to the Hindu ritual of Vrishotsarga during Shraddha ceremonies where a bull is released in the name of the deceased, symbolizing liberation but sometimes misused.
note: Idiom highlights cultural practices in Bengal tied to Hindu traditions.
